name: giveaway-prize-picker
title_zh: 抽奖奖品选品师：先算转化率再谈吸引力
tagline_zh: 别拍脑袋送网红单品。它按你的涨粉目标、预算上限和物流成本，筛出真正能拉新又送得起的奖品组合。
tagline_en: Stop guessing what to give away. It picks prizes that actually grow your audience, fit your budget, and won't.
desc_en: Choose or evaluate a giveaway prize that attracts the intended audience, supports the business objective, and fits budget and fulfillment constraints. Use when the user asks 'what should we give away', 'prize ideas', 'is X a good prize', 'what prize should we offer', 'Instagram giveaway prize', 'giveaway budget', 'prize bundle', 'what prize gets the most entries', or mentions a giveaway, contest,
why_zh: 把「奖品吸引力」拆成可计算的指标：目标人群重合度、参与门槛、履约成本三条线交叉验证。
why_en: Turns 'will people like this?' into three measurable axes—audience overlap, entry friction, fulfillment cost—so you pick prizes.
limit_zh: 只覆盖奖品选型和评估，不碰活动文案、抽奖机制或平台规则。需要你提供预算上限、目标人群画像和可发货地区。
limit_en: Covers prize selection/evaluation only—no copywriting, mechanics, or platform rules. Needs your budget cap, audience profile, and ship-to regions.
title_en: Giveaway prize picker: conversion first, appeal second
